Annotate Cell Types Using CellTypist (Python Backend)

Source: R/51-CellTypistAnnotate.R
CellTypistAnnotate.Rd

Performs automated cell type annotation via the celltypist Python package using reticulate integration. Accepts a Seurat object as input and returns it enriched with CellTypist prediction results as metadata columns.

Requires a Python environment with celltypist installed (see https://github.com/Teichlab/celltypist). By default the function locates a suitable Python interpreter automatically via reticulate; use reticulate::use_python() to pin a specific environment beforehand.

Usage

CellTypistAnnotate(sc, ...)

# Default S3 method
CellTypistAnnotate(sc, ...)

# S3 method for class '`SigBridgeR::ScreenMethodResult`'
CellTypistAnnotate(sc, ...)

# S3 method for class 'SingleCellExperiment'
CellTypistAnnotate(sc, ...)

# S3 method for class 'Seurat'
CellTypistAnnotate(
  sc,
  model = NULL,
  download = TRUE,
  force_update = FALSE,
  majority_voting = FALSE,
  mode = c("best match", "prob match"),
  p_thres = 0.5,
  transpose_input = FALSE,
  gene_file = NULL,
  cell_file = NULL,
  over_clustering = NULL,
  use_GPU = FALSE,
  min_prop = 0L,
  verbose = getFuncOption("verbose"),
  assay = "RNA",
  ...
)

Arguments

sc

A single-cell dataset, one of:

  • A Seurat object (recommended) with a valid assay and gene expression matrix;

  • A SingleCellExperiment object, converted to Seurat via Seurat::as.Seurat() before annotation (requires counts/logcounts assays);

  • A ScreenMethodResult object, whose scRNA_data slot is annotated.

...

Additional arguments passed through to the CellTypist Python backend.

model

Character. CellTypist model specification. One of:

  • A built-in model name (e.g., "Immune_All_Low"); a .pkl suffix is appended automatically if missing.

  • A path to a local .pkl model file.

download

Logical. Whether to automatically download the model first. Default: TRUE.

force_update

Logical. Whether to force re-downloading the model files when download = TRUE. Default: FALSE.

majority_voting

Logical. Whether to refine predicted labels by running a majority voting classifier after over-clustering. Default: FALSE.

mode

Character. Prediction mode: "best match" selects the cell type with the largest score; "prob match" enables multi-label classification. Default: "best match".

p_thres

Numeric. Probability threshold for multi-label classification in "prob match" mode. Ignored when mode = "best match". Default: 0.5.

transpose_input

Logical. Whether to transpose the input matrix. Set to TRUE if the input is in gene-by-cell format. Default: FALSE.

gene_file

Character. Path to a file with genes (one per line) corresponding to rows of the input matrix. Default: NULL.

cell_file

Character. Path to a file with cells (one per line) corresponding to columns of the input matrix. Default: NULL.

over_clustering

Character or vector. Over-clustering specification used for majority voting: (1) path to a plain file with one cluster ID per line; (2) metadata column name in AnnData; (3) vector/array of cluster assignments; or (4) omitted for the heuristic approach. Ignored when majority_voting = FALSE. Default: NULL.

use_GPU

Logical. Whether to use GPU acceleration (via rapids-singlecell) for over-clustering. Only relevant when majority_voting = TRUE. Default: FALSE.

min_prop

Numeric. Minimum proportion of the dominant cell type required to name a subcluster; subclusters below the threshold are labeled 'Heterogeneous'. Ignored when majority_voting = FALSE. Default: 0L.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress messages during annotation. Default: getFuncOption("verbose").

assay

which Seurat assay to use

Value

The input Seurat object with prediction results added: cell type labels are stored as new columns in meta.data (prefixed with celltypist_), and the scoring matrices are stored in misc$celltypist. Column names may vary slightly depending on the CellTypist version and options used. SingleCellExperiment and ScreenMethodResult inputs are annotated as Seurat objects and returned as such.

Requirements

  • R packages: reticulate, AnnDataR

  • Python packages: celltypist, scanpy, anndata

  • A working Python environment discoverable by reticulate

See also

Other Single_Cell_Annotation_Method: DownloadCellTypistModels(), ListCellTypistModels(), RegisterAnnoMethod(), SCAnnotateStrategy, SingleRAnnotate(), mLLMCelltypeAnnotate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Use a built-in immune model with majority voting
annotated <- CellTypistAnnotate(
  sc = seurat_obj,
  model = "Immune_All_Low",
  majority_voting = TRUE
)

# Probability-based multi-label annotation
annotated <- CellTypistAnnotate(
  sc = seurat_obj,
  model = "Immune_All_Low",
  mode = "prob match",
  p_thres = 0.5
)

# Use a local model file
annotated <- CellTypistAnnotate(
  sc = seurat_obj,
  model = "/path/to/My_Model.pkl"
)
} # }
